axis_calibration.calibration_method: independent visual/source review from rendered supplement page tick marks; values remain approximate digitization of visible plotted markers

x_axis.uncertainty_uM: about +/-2 uM for visually digitized points

y_axis.uncertainty_percent: about +/-3 percentage points; near-zero points are clamped to 0 when calibration gives a small negative value

observations.uncertainty: about +/-3 percentage points for hemolysis and +/-2 uM for concentration
